The school had operated at the location since 1992.

'Contest UP polls from Ayodhya': Akhilesh Yadav dares CM Yogi Adityanath
stories.summary: Akhilesh Yadav has urged Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest the upcoming assembly elections from Ayodhya. He indicated plans to visit the Ram temple alongside SP leaders after visiting Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah. Yadav also noted that the BJP has been conducting surveys for the Ayodhya seat, claiming they are struggling to find a candidate to challenge him. This statement responds to BJP allegations about his temple visitations.

stories.title: France student protests escalate in Paris: Clashes erupt, police fire tear gas
Indian students make extraordinary contributions to our campus, says Indian American President of University of Arizona Suresh Garimella
2 Latvian men arrested near UK airbase housing US, Nato intelligence operations
Increase in crime due to SC's forgiving nature: Top court judge
Texas student returns to college after 10 years, earns national leadership honour
CM Pushkar Singh Dhami attends 7th CII Uttarakhand Industrial Summit and Expo-2026 in Haridwar
stories.summary: Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Thursday attended the 7th Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) Uttarakhand Industrial Summit and Expo-2026 in Haridwar.

stories.title: Metallica’s job-training programme grows from 10 to 93 US colleges with $17M investment
stories.summary: In 2019, Metallica's All Within My Hands foundation introduced the Metallica Scholars Initiative, aiming to bolster workforce education. Initially partnering with 10 community colleges, the program has significantly grown, reaching 93 learning institutions nationwide. By 2026, this initiative has seen an investment of over $17 million, enhancing technical education and equipping students for rewarding careers. Additionally, it has successfully introduced a similar program in the UK.

stories.title: Veteran actor Nana Patekar dies of cardiac arrest: Why every minute counts
FSSAI flags GLP-1 food claims, cracks down on rotten food, pesticide-tainted raisins
CAPF law comes into force, mandates IPS quota in senior posts
US charges former Venezuela president Maduro with conspiracy to torture opponents
stories.summary: The new allegations accuse Maduro of authorising torture, arbitrary detention and violence against opponents during his time as president. The indictment says thousands of Venezuelans were “harassed, threatened, arrested, prosecuted, assaulted, tortured, or killed” by people acting at the direction of his government. It alleges that methods of abuse included electric shocks, beatings and asphyxiation.

stories.title: Bypolls results 2026: Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Assam and Puducherry brace for closely watched verdicts
stories.summary: The bypolls were held on Tuesday, October 6, in Nandigram and Rejinagar in West Bengal, Madurantakam and Dharapuram in Tamil Nadu, Nagaon in Assam and Thattanchavady in Puducherry. Counting of votes in all six constituencies is scheduled for Friday, with the process beginning at 8 am. The results across these six contests, by the end of the day, would provide more than individual winners and losers.

stories.title: India to come out with a national plan to boost small-scale fisheries sector
Govt proposes prior approval for ads of Schedule H, H1 and X drugs
'Welcome to India': Rahul Gandhi reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi has weighed in on Elon Musk's comments about the hold-up of Starlink's commercial operations in India. Musk voiced his exasperation over regulatory obstacles, suggesting that oligarchs sway the industry. The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.

stories.title: INDIA bloc protests against CEC: 'Unite to fight' proposes Uddhav's Sena; will AAP, DMK relent?
stories.summary: Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena has called on AAP and DMK to join opposition forces against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in SIR. Despite AAP's separation from the INDIA bloc and DMK's mixed reactions, the lack of participation from both factions underscores existing rifts in the opposition landscape. Analysts argue that these parties might still rally together to uphold democratic principles, though future collaboration remains clouded by their historical rivalries.

stories.title: Musk goes on rant after India rejects ‘oligarch’ claim: What makes Starlink controversial
'Remain alert, stay indoors': India issues advisory for citizens in Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
New lawsuit against Green Card rules: Why separate family members by sending the applicants out of country
'BJP's poll campaign has begun': Mann on CBI raids on OSD, 5 others
stories.summary: Punjab's Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann has leveled allegations against the BJP, claiming the use of Central investigative agencies for political leverage. He interpreted the recent CBI raids on his office as a signal of an impending election campaign. Mann reiterated his dedication to the interests of Punjab's citizens, dismissing corruption claims and drawing parallels with similar tactics in other states with non-BJP leadership.

stories.title: Serena Williams helped build Jamaica school for 80 preschool children in 2016
stories.summary: Serena Williams has taken an admirable step towards education by contributing to the Salt Marsh Basic School in Trelawny, Jamaica. This school provides free preschool education to local children, significantly improving their access to learning. By physically participating in the building process alongside other volunteers, Williams showcased the value of community collaboration in fostering educational growth and ensuring a safe space for the children.

stories.title: Royal Navy sailor charged under UK National Security Act of spying for Russia
California father builds 180-foot backyard roller coaster after son asks for one
stories.summary: A California father constructed a 180-foot roller coaster for his son after the child expressed interest. They spent six weeks working on the project, which cost around $3,500 to complete. The father used the project as an educational opportunity to teach his son about physics and mathematics throughout the construction process. Neighbors became curious and followed the project as it progressed in their backyard.

stories.title: Bajrang Dal says no volunteers to be mobilised at Jantar Mantar on October 10
stories.summary: Bajrang Dal firmly refuted claims of organizing a gathering at Jantar Mantar on October 10 for their demonstration. The group expressed discontent over being linked to potential violence against protesters. CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka voiced concerns over right-wing groups being mobilized for violent purposes. Bajrang Dal confidently stated that the protest would not succeed due to insufficient public backing, reinforcing their long-standing disapproval of disruptive protests across the nation.

stories.title: Italy passes Meloni’s electoral reform, sets 42% threshold for parliamentary majority
Texas doctor spent 40 years restoring family land; $10M ranch becomes wildlife area
Who is 'cybercrime specialist' Daniel Robson? Canadian publications pulled down his articles after two years because he is possibly AI
Israel-Britain ties hit new low as Jerusalem consulate loses diplomatic status
stories.summary: Britain and Israel continue to cooperate closely on defence and security, but their wider diplomatic relationship has deteriorated over Israel's conduct of the war against Hamas in Gaza and Britain's decision last year to recognise a Palestinian state. The dispute over the consulate comes against the backdrop of the wider Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

stories.title: India’s data silos cost up to 7% of welfare spending, threaten AI push: Report
stories.summary: India processes over 20 billion UPI transactions monthly and has enrolled more than 1.4 billion Aadhaar users. However, fragmented government databases are causing financial losses and excluding eligible beneficiaries from welfare schemes. Past data-cleaning efforts have shown significant savings, but data systems largely operate independently, limiting their effectiveness. The report emphasizes the importance of accurate and accessible data for improving governance and deploying AI.

stories.title: 'Dhappa' gets a Day 3 twist as police allow Rahul, INDIA bloc MPs to protest at Raj Ghat
stories.summary: Opposition leaders, after previously being stopped by police, successfully reached Raj Ghat for their protest. They staged a brief sit-in to honor Mahatma Gandhi while voicing their concerns about electoral integrity. Congress leaders accused the government and Election Commission of undermining democratic rights and engaging in a conspiracy. Rahul Gandhi emphasized the need for justice regarding these electoral issues.

stories.title: Air India Delhi-Riyadh flight returns after Houthi attack on Saudi airport; flights ops suspended till October 10
Centre to unveil AI regulation roadmap within a month; industry to shoulder safety responsibility
stories.summary: In a major initiative, the Centre will unveil a consultation paper in the coming month to propose new regulations for artificial intelligence. These guidelines are set to focus on safety, inclusivity, and the handling of emerging threats such as deepfakes and psychological effects. The responsibility for implementation will lie primarily with industry leaders within a techno-legal framework, accompanied by a roadmap for developing homegrown GPUs.

stories.title: How a $5 million fundraising drive and Rockefeller gift helped create Great Smoky Mountains National Park
stories.summary: The establishment of Great Smoky Mountains National Park was a remarkable achievement that required overcoming significant financial challenges due to increasing land prices. Initial fundraising efforts gathered $5 million, but this amount quickly proved insufficient as prices soared. The Rockefeller family stepped in, matching previous contributions with an additional $5 million, allowing for crucial land acquisitions.

stories.title: From France to Italy, Belgium to Greece, student protests spread across Europe
stories.summary: The movement began in the Paris region in mid-September, when high-school students and teachers protested over a lack of resources and staff. It quickly spread across France, with students blocking school entrances and later joined by university students, parents and trade unions. Their complaints include overcrowded classrooms, teachers not being replaced when absent, long school hours, deteriorating buildings and inequalities between schools in wealthier and poorer areas.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Nana Patekar passes away, stock market crash, Rahul Gandhi's Day 3 protest and more
stories.summary: In a strong show of solidarity, forty-two former judges have rallied behind Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amidst ongoing protests. They condemned the negative sentiments directed at him, labeling them as politically driven. Meanwhile, veteran actor Nana Patekar sadly passed away at 75 from cardiac arrest. Additionally, the stock market saw a considerable decline following the Reserve Bank of India's recent policy changes.

stories.title: Delhi liquor shops to remain closed on Oct 9-10 amid ‘prevailing’ situation
Guns, gold & tolls: How Congo’s militias and guerrillas profit from the M23 war
CBI busts multi-state IBPS exam impersonation racket; CGST inspector among 4 arrested
Egypt arrests 6 journalists from fact-checking website over ‘terrorism’, ‘fake news’ charges
Trainee solicitor Archie Hunt broke Dracula's 14-year marathon record in costume
Delhi Police crime branch registers FIR to probe those behind July 20 CJP protest violence
stories.summary: On July 20, the protesters, gathered on the appeal of the CJP, were marching towards Parliament when the situation turned tensed as demonstrators attempted to move towards Parliament and breach police barricades in central Delhi, security personnel used tear gas and lathi-charge to disperse the protesters. Several videos subsequently circulated on social media, purportedly showing protesters being manhandled by police personnel, leading to allegations of excessive use of force.

stories.title: John Paul DeJoria’s Texas ranch sold for $6.93 million; 120 exotic animals included
stories.summary: In a remarkable real estate deal, the sprawling Texas ranch of Patrón Tequila co-founder John Paul DeJoria has been acquired for $6.93 million. Spanning 96 acres, this unique property was home to over 120 exotic African animals, including gazelles and wildebeest. Complete with a luxurious main residence and an underground shelter, the estate also boasted a well-stocked pond.

stories.title: Meet Advay Jain: Indian-American kid who made Guinness record as the youngest person to publish a book. He was 3 when he wrote 'Dino Learns Not To Waste Food'
Meet US collector John Reznikoff, who owns $1m worth of hair from Lincoln, Monroe
NSW protects first pink lakes: governments buy Pulgamurtie Station
stories.summary: The acquisition of Pulgamurtie Station in New South Wales, covering 74,000 hectares of unique landscapes, aims to protect the area's stunning pink lakes and vulnerable wildlife. This initiative not only prioritizes Aboriginal cultural heritage but also fosters diverse ecosystems vital for local species. Future plans include opportunities for recreational activities like birdwatching and scenic drives, supporting Australia's goal to expand protected areas.

stories.title: Stanford’s 20-year blood-cancer therapy treats first commercial patient; trial found 78% free of GVHD
stories.summary: In a remarkable advancement, Stanford researchers have unveiled Orca-T therapy, which has recently received FDA approval. After two decades of rigorous development, this innovative treatment was administered to its inaugural commercial patient, a high-risk leukemia sufferer. Notably, Orca-T significantly minimizes the chances of graft-versus-host disease post-stem cell transplants, offering reduced chemotherapy requirements and lower side effects. Future studies are anticipated to investigate its relevance for broader patient demographics.

stories.title: Stanford Nobel winner pauses celebration to make lunch for his children
Marriage fraud, duplicate identity: 4 Pakistani men to lose US citizenship in largest denaturalization move by the Trump administration
DoorDash driver in Maryland crashes during delivery, still arranges for customer to collect food
stories.summary: A DoorDash driver in Maryland, US, survived a serious crash after his car's brakes failed during a delivery. Despite the accident, he told his customer where to collect the food. The customer's video of the unusual pickup went viral, drawing attention to the driver's financial difficulties. An online fundraiser later raised over $16,000 to help him recover.

stories.title: 'Will be doing injustice to my alliance partners': Chirag Paswan says his party has identified 'A' category seats for UP polls
‘Let them hit Los Angeles’: Trump clarifies Iran war remarks, says he ‘won’t let that happen’
Greenland fishers offer $45 per heart to cull 1,000 sharks; plan halted over legality
Stun grenades, severed hand: France's student protests put police under scrutiny
Govt caps trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP
'Calculated campaign driven by vested political interests': 42 ex-judges back Gyanesh Kumar in open letter
stories.summary: Veterans said that "criticism of institutions is a democratic right. Denigration is not". They also hit out at the Congress party, which has double-down its verbal assault on Gyanesh Kumar, by questioning how the party's victory through the same EVM goes unquestioned. The ex-service members also highlighted how ECI's demand for sworn declaration was not submitted by the Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi.

stories.title: 39,815 rural families get pucca houses in Uttarakhand under PMAY-G
stories.summary: Since 2022, a total of 39,815 rural families in Uttarakhand received pucca houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin. Udham Singh Nagar led with 4,882 houses built, followed closely by Haridwar and Rudraprayag with significant contributions. The state government has sought additional housing allocations from the Centre to continue supporting the initiative. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive direct financial assistance for effective housing construction.

stories.title: 'Criminal conspiracy to hijack India': Rahul ups the ante against govt, CEC
India, Kazakhstan review bilateral ties, vow to deepen partnership
stories.summary: India and Kazakhstan reviewed their bilateral relations during a meeting between Deputy Foreign Minister Arman Issagaliyev and Ambassador YK Sailas Thangal. The officials discussed opportunities to enhance mutual understanding and strengthen their strategic partnership. This meeting followed discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev at the recent BRICS Summit. They evaluated cooperation in various sectors, including trade, defense, and emerging technologies.

stories.title: Times Prime rolls out Rs 1 lakh reward envelopes across 5,000 Daalchini vending machines
'I have not come here for regime change': Dhruv Rathee during CJP protest in Bengaluru
'Targeting civilian infrastructure unacceptable': India condemns Houthis attack on Riyadh airports
Plea in Supreme Court challenges appointment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, two election commissioners
Stephen Hawking wrote A Brief History of Time in a villa later replaced by his namesake
Beyond condoms: WHO blueprint for new male contraceptives
stories.summary: Pills, gels, injections, implants and reversible sperm-blocking methods among approaches; Indian RISUG has completed Phase 1, 2 trials

stories.title: East Hampton Land Purchase: town eyes $36.3m Wainscott mine buy; most acres set as open space
stories.summary: East Hampton Town plans to acquire 38.3 acres of a former sand mine in Wainscott for $36.3 million. The purchase aims to preserve the land for parks and open space, reserving a smaller section for municipal needs. This decision marks a significant change from prior contentious commercial development proposals in the area. A public hearing is set for October 15 to allow residents to voice their opinions.

stories.title: Nevada's 700-acre Shakespeare Ranch, listed for $188 million in 2024, now asks $125 million
stories.summary: Nevada’s historic Shakespeare Ranch, first listed for $188 million in 2024, is now asking $125 million after failing to find a buyer. The 700-acre Lake Tahoe estate features multiple homes, a 465-foot private pier and a barn built in 1873. Despite strong demand for luxury waterfront properties in the region, the ranch remains unsold.

stories.title: ‘Slap’ row: Delhi HC seeks Parvesh Verma, police response on plea for independent probe
'Not bragging': Trump makes fresh pitch for Nobel Peace Prize, citing '8 settled wars'
‘Iran will never have a nuclear weapon’: Rubio draws red line for Tehran
'Inappropriate': BJP turns heat on Rahul Gandhi over 'clash' with female Delhi cop during anti-CEC protest
stories.summary: BJP leaders escalated attacks on Rahul Gandhi following his protests against the Election Commission. C R Kesavan accused Gandhi of inappropriate behavior toward a female police officer during the protest. Nitin Nabin labeled Gandhi as having an anarchist mindset and suggested he resign if he disagrees with the Election Commission. The Congress party has expressed demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over recent decisions.

stories.title: 'Left lasting imprint': PM Modi visits LK Advani on completing 25 years as head of govt
Two runners set a world record in a giant inflatable elephant at the London Marathon
stories.summary: Jo Robinson and Emma Langstaff made a splash at the London Marathon by donning a giant inflatable elephant costume, achieving a remarkable world record time of 4:15:40. This memorable run was motivated by Robinson's connection to type one diabetes, as her daughters live with the condition. Despite minimal training in their costume, the duo effectively supported one another.

stories.title: Arizona’s leopard frogs show signs of recovery across 19 sites by 2019
Minnesota Home Price Record: Lake Minnetonka estate sells for $18.25m; luxury market surges
stories.summary: An exceptional estate on Lake Minnetonka in Deephaven has achieved a remarkable milestone by selling for $18.25 million. Nestled at 20670 Linwood Road, this stunning property covers roughly 2.39 acres and features 350 feet of pristine shoreline. Crafted by the talented Charles Stinson, the modern home offers an expansive 10,440 square feet complete with five luxurious bedrooms and nine upscale bathrooms, breaking the previous record of $17.

stories.title: Lost wallet from 1975 found 51 years later with birth certificate, $1 and Hamlet ticket inside
stories.summary: Lost wallet from 1975 found 51 years later with birth certificate, $1 and Hamlet ticket inside

stories.title: ‘Alert, ready’: IAF chief AP Singh hails combat speed during Operation Sindoor on Air Force Day
FIR against Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi over 'assault' during anti-Gyanesh Kumar protest in Delhi
stories.summary: The Delhi Police have filed an FIR against Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra for allegedly assaulting police officers during a demonstration aimed at highlighting electoral roll discrepancies. The police complaint also mentions other party leaders and workers. Tensions increased when law enforcement intercepted demonstrators en route to Jantar Mantar, resulting in the detention of 91 individuals, including political figures and MPs.

stories.title: 'No excuse for victim blaming': Mamdani under fire from Democrats over Oct 7 message
Coastal Forest Loss Speeds Up: Albemarle Peninsula trees retreat 21%; ghost forests spread faster
stories.summary: Over the last 36 years, North Carolina's coastal forests have seen a dramatic decrease in forest cover. The decline sped up after 2010 due to rising sea levels and increased salinity. The research revealed a troubling shift, with once green areas transforming into marshes, shrubs, or ghost forests. Moreover, extreme weather events have intensified the threat of saltwater intrusion, making these forests increasingly vulnerable.

stories.title: After 6 generations of family ownership, Holly Hill Farm gets a new future
stories.summary: Following six generations of dedication, Holly Hill Farm has successfully been secured as an active agricultural hub in Massachusetts. The Friends of Holly Hill Farm raised over $4.9 million, allowing them to purchase and maintain the site. The nonprofit will run the farm with a focus on facility improvements and community engagement, providing educational resources to 20,000 students each year and donating produce to local food banks.

stories.title: ‘What will it achieve?’: BJP’s Ghosh on Mamata’s Delhi visit as INDIA bloc seeks Prez meet over SIR
‘Few actors possessed his intensity’: PM Modi mourns Nana Patekar
Pakistan's terror monsters now wreak havoc in its own backyard: India at UN
'Expecting life-threatening impacts': Tropical storm Isaias to strike US Gulf Coast as hurricane
NTPC identifies 3 locations for nuclear power projects
stories.summary: The public sector powerhouse, NTPC, has earmarked three strategic locations across India for the establishment of nuclear power plants. Situated in Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, and Odisha, these sites are projected to support a significant capacity expansion of up to 30GW. Feasibility reports have been submitted to the Atomic Energy Commission for thorough appraisal, while NTPC explores potential partnerships with international technology firms to enhance the initiative.

stories.title: Texas carries out first US execution since Christa Pike's botched lethal injection
Rupee may be undervalued, markets can be irrational: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra
stories.summary: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra indicated that the rupee is undervalued and the central bank will intervene. The rupee closed at 96.78, down 36 paise from the previous day, hitting a five-month low. Malhotra mentioned that global AI stock corrections could attract foreign capital to India. Despite a robust services trade surplus, the current account deficit has widened due to increased merchandise trade deficit.

stories.title: Supreme Court to study plea for recall of split verdict on EC appointment law
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to examine a plea concerning a recent split verdict related to a 2023 election law. This law alters the appointment process for the Chief Election Commissioner and other election commissioners. The split verdict occurred between Justices Dipankar Datta and Satish Chandra Sharma on whether to refer the matter to a larger Constitution bench.

stories.title: Congress protest: Delhi Police to scan videos to identify protesters accused of assaulting personnel; FIR likely
stories.summary: Delhi Police is reviewing videos to identify protesters involved in the alleged assault during a Congress protest. Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi were detained for defying police orders while attempting to proceed to Jantar Mantar. Police are also taking action against misleading social media posts regarding their conduct during the protest. Earlier, an FIR was lodged against Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi for forcibly entering Akashvani Bhawan.

stories.title: 25 years in governance: President, world leaders, allies hail PM Modi
stories.summary: PM Narendra Modi received congratulations from leaders including President Droupadi Murmu for his 25 years in government. Home Minister Amit Shah highlighted Modi's commitment to the welfare of the poor and women's empowerment. Various international leaders expressed admiration for Modi's leadership and vision for development. Bhutan's Prime Minister likened Modi to an enlightened ruler while acknowledging his influence on Indian self-belief.

stories.title: 'Fight goes on’: 87-yr-old woman dies after becoming symbol of Spain housing crisis
stories.summary: María del Carmen Abascal, known as Maricarmen, died in a hospital after being evicted from her home. Her eviction triggered nationwide protests highlighting the housing crisis afflicting Spain. Activists voiced anger over Maricarmen's death as a symbol of the struggle against rising rents and evictions. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez offered condolences, acknowledging the impact of her case on public sentiment.

stories.title: DoxyPEP Claim Debunked: Peters links daily doxycycline to plague; doctors say no evidence
stories.summary: Clavicular has sparked controversy after claiming that doxycycline, which he says he takes as part of his looksmaxxing routine, can prevent “the plague in Russia.” The influencer’s comments are medically unsupported. DoxyPEP is used to reduce the risk of certain STIs, including chlamydia and syphilis, after sexual exposure. It is not established protection against pneumonic plague. His comments come shortly after he was charged with rape and drugging a person for sex.

stories.title: Doctors, hospitals can't use AI to create testimonials: National Medical Commission
stories.summary: National Medical Commission has issued guidelines restricting the use of AI in medical advertising and patient testimonials. Registered medical practitioners and hospitals must not engage in creating synthetic content or manipulating search rankings. Claims of being the best or offering guaranteed results are also prohibited under these rules. Additionally, offering discounts or referrals that encourage unnecessary consultations is not allowed.

stories.title: Targeting of sailors must end, says government
stories.summary: India has condemned recent attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea, which have injured Indian seafarers. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) emphasized the need for immediate cessation of violence. Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar mentioned ongoing communication with Russia and Ukraine regarding safe shipping proposals. India is addressing concerns related to both grain and energy exports during these discussions.

stories.title: Make a good film, repay your debts: Supreme Court to Rajpal Yadav
stories.summary: Supreme Court has maintained the condition for Rajpal Yadav to deposit Rs 2 crore for his appeal. Yadav took a loan of Rs 5 crore in 2010 for a film that never completed, which has accrued interest. His counsel mentioned he secured Rs 1.15 crore and aims to sell property to cover remaining dues. The court suggested producing a successful film may help him repay the debts.

stories.title: Stark 73% decline in the average size of monitored wildlife populations since 1970, India presents ground for hope: WWF Living Planet Report
stories.summary: A global decline of 73% in monitored wildlife populations occurred between 1970 and 2022. India has successfully improved populations of tigers, one-horned rhinos, and Ganga river dolphins. The report highlights threats like habitat loss, climate change, and pollution affecting wildlife. Despite the negative trends, about half of monitored populations are stable or increasing globally. Targeted conservation efforts in India demonstrate the potential for wildlife recovery and biodiversity preservation.

stories.title: Northern lights may return to US, Canada October 8-9: Where and when to watch the aurora show
stories.summary: Northern lights may return across parts of the US and Canada overnight October 8-9 as a CME reaches Earth after an M1.4 solar flare. NOAA forecasts G1 to G2 geomagnetic storm conditions, with activity potentially strengthening early Friday. Alaska, Canada and northern US states have the best viewing chances under dark skies.

stories.title: Mamata Banerjee’s Delhi arrival fuels buzz over INDIA bloc meet with President
stories.summary: TMC chairperson Mamata Banerjee's arrival in Delhi has heightened anticipation for the requested meeting with President Droupadi Murmu. The opposition bloc is awaiting confirmation for a meeting date between October 7 and 9. The delegation has been limited to ten members as requested by the President's Secretariat. CPI(M)'s John Brittas has submitted a petition for constitutional intervention regarding the Election Commission.

stories.title: Centre cites Supreme Court order, seeks to void Jharkhand DGP appointment
stories.summary: Supreme Court has agreed to hear the application from the Centre regarding Tadasha Mishra's appointment as Jharkhand DGP. The appointment has been challenged due to its conflict with procedures set in the SC's 2006 Prakash Singh judgement. Moreover, the Centre claimed that prior DGP appointments in Jharkhand were also illegal for similar reasons. Mishra's appointment occurred shortly before her retirement, which raised legal concerns.

stories.title: Chicago’s vacant LeClaire Courts site set for $127M redevelopment with 183 homes in first phase
stories.summary: The Chicago city council has recently granted approval for redevelopment plans at the LeClaire Courts site. The initial phase will feature two six-story buildings containing 183 apartments and a childcare facility, with approximately 90 percent of the units designated for low-income households. Set to begin construction in late 2026, this project aims to breathe new life into the area, fostering community and connectivity where it has long been absent.

stories.title: 'Cash-for transfers' WhatsApp chats part of CBI dossier on Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann OSD
stories.summary: A set of WhatsApp chats has emerged, alleging monetary transactions involving senior Punjab government officials and DSPs. CBI's dossier includes these chats as they prepare to interrogate CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD Rajbir Singh Ghuman. Allegations suggest that intermediaries received bribes for influencing transfers and policy formulations affecting IAS and IPS officers. Additionally, documents indicate potential irregularities in real estate projects and the Greater Mohali Area Development Authority.

stories.title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
stories.summary: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.

stories.title: Medical trips costliest in both rural & urban areas
stories.summary: Health and medical trips incurred the highest expenses in rural and urban areas during a one-year period. The average expenditure for these trips was notably higher in urban than rural areas. Pilgrimage travel accounted for the largest share of trips taken throughout the year. Accommodation and transport were significant expenditures for health and medical trips, underscoring their financial impact.

stories.title: With PM Modi set to visit Ottawa, India & Canada back CEPA
stories.summary: India and Canada are currently engaged in the fifth round of talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both countries aim to sign the CEPA during Prime Minister Modi's anticipated visit to Canada. The visit is tentatively scheduled for December 11-13, just before the G20 summit in Florida. Leaders from both nations envision boosting bilateral trade to CAD 70 billion by 2030.

stories.title: Assam CM Himanta Sarma says woman sent to Bangladesh safe, son counters CM
stories.summary: Mumtaz Begum, a woman expelled to Bangladesh, remains untraceable by her family despite official claims of her safety. Her son, Momruz Ali, is pleading for government assistance to locate her in either country. The Gauhati High Court directed authorities to find Mumtaz and provide interim compensation to her husband. Reports indicate that searches in Bangladesh yielded no results for her whereabouts so far.

stories.title: Sharks’ Long-Range Hearing: Study finds 74m sound detection; sharks turn away
stories.summary: A team of researchers from Florida Atlantic University discovered that wild blacktip sharks possess the ability to detect low-frequency sounds from considerable distances. This groundbreaking study sheds light on how these sharks navigate their aquatic environments, as they exhibited keen directional hearing by making sharp turns in response to sound sources.

stories.title: In 2025, 48 solar panels went between Swiss tracks; today, 11,000 trains have passed over them
stories.summary: In 2025, Swiss startup Sun-Ways installed 48 removable solar panels across 100 metres of active railway tracks in Buttes. More than 11,000 trains have since passed over the installation, which has generated over 16,000 kWh of electricity. The three-year pilot is testing whether unused railway space can safely produce renewable energy without disrupting operations.

stories.title: Ricky Martin’s former Beverly Hills mansion sells for $35M
stories.summary: A luxurious Beverly Hills mansion was recently sold for $35 million after being on the market for four months. Originally listed at $75 million, the price was reduced significantly due to lack of buyers despite its celebrity ownership history. The estate features a main residence, a guest house, and various recreational amenities including a tennis court and children's playground.

stories.title: 'One student, one day': CUET-UG 2027 may get shorter, simpler
stories.summary: CUET-UG 2027 may implement notable changes to streamline the examination experience for students. Candidates could see a reduction in the number of subjects from five to four over time. The proposed changes also include shortening the duration of individual papers to enhance efficiency. Subject grouping may allow related papers to be scheduled together for a single-day examination.

stories.title: Anti-CEC protests: Opposition, police face off again; Rahul Gandhi says won’t stop till Gyanesh quits
stories.summary: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc attempted to stage a protest demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. They were detained by Delhi Police less than a kilometer from their protest site at Jantar Mantar. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge organized the lunch gathering, where the protest plan was discussed. Difficulties in moving their buses led to further confrontations with police as they sought to demonstrate.

stories.title: William Kent bought 611 acres of redwood forest for $45,000 in 1905; 3 years later it became Muir Woods
stories.summary: William and Elizabeth Kent purchased land in Redwood Canyon and donated it to create Muir Woods National Monument. The area became protected after a legal dispute over a proposed reservoir threatened the redwood grove. President Theodore Roosevelt proclaimed it a national monument in 1908, marking the first land donation for such purpose. Elizabeth Kent played a significant but often overlooked role in this conservation effort.

stories.title: 'We'll do it': PM Modi gives slogan for 2047 goals; credits people’s support for 25-year unbroken run
stories.summary: PM Narendra Modi delivered a speech highlighting his 25 years in government and the goal of developed India by 2047. He called upon citizens to commit to this ambitious target and emphasized the power of the people. Modi reiterated the importance of extraordinary goals, linking good governance to societal inclusion. He reflected on his journey from humble beginnings to leadership in the BJP.

stories.title: $1.50 thrifted clutch turns out to be Cartier; valued at $35,000 on Antiques Roadshow
stories.summary: A thrift-store shopper who paid just $1.50 for a clutch in 2018 or 2019 discovered years later that it was a rare Cartier Art Deco piece. During a 2026 "Antiques Roadshow" appraisal, experts identified precious stones, platinum and the Cartier name inside, valuing the purse at about $35,000, with an insurance value above $100,000.

stories.title: Ellison Seeks Higher Price? Larry relists Seminole Beach estate for $165 million; potential record land sale
stories.summary: Larry Ellison is putting his North Palm Beach estate back on the market, initially acquired for $80 million, now with a hefty asking price of $165 million. He believes this reflects an undervaluation of Indian culinary traditions compared to European cuisine. The restaurant has a significant historical background with notable patrons, including Indian leaders. The Crown Estate maintains its decision is based on structural issues and not culinary bias.

stories.title: Noah’s Ark mystery deepens as archaeologists drill Mount Ararat site for ancient wood clues
stories.summary: Archaeologists investigating Turkey’s Mount Ararat have drilled the boat-shaped Durupinar formation for the first time, collecting hundreds of soil samples from depths of up to 60 feet. Researchers are examining organic matter and possible traces of ancient wood for clues linked to Noah’s Ark, but laboratory analysis is still needed before drawing conclusions.

stories.summary: A special NIA court in Jammu has declared Nazir Hussain a proclaimed offender regarding grenade seizures. Hussain, originally from Hari village, is believed to be hiding in Pakistan currently. The court noted that previous non-bailable arrest warrants could not be executed due to his absence from home. stories.title: India’s first high-altitude snow leopard safari flagged off in Ladakh
stories.summary: Ladakh has commenced India's first high-altitude wildlife safari that highlights snow leopard trails and community involvement. stories.title: Texas ranch hit by wildfire returns for $180 million
stories.summary: Now listed for $180 million, Turkey Track Ranch encompasses 77,721 acres of breathtaking terrain. After rebounding from the Smokehouse Creek Fire, this property has rejuvenated its cattle operations and features nearly 26 miles of scenic Canadian River frontage, ensuring abundant water supply. With a lineage connected to essential battles and over a hundred years of family ownership, this sale is a unique opportunity to own a remarkable piece of history.

stories.title: Oceans connect, not divide nations, PM Modi says, calls for secure maritime order
stories.summary: PM Narendra Modi emphasized the importance of maritime connectivity and proposed a ceasefire plan for the Black Sea. His vision promotes cooperation and mutual benefit among nations to ensure maritime security. Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan highlighted the interconnectedness of national security and economic security. He urged for collective action among regions to tackle maritime threats effectively.

stories.title: FBI foils alleged ISIS-linked attack plot at Mall of America by 18-year-old
stories.summary: Sheikhdoon Abdullahi Mohamud, an 18-year-old, was arrested for planning an attack on the Mall of America. He agreed to buy an AK-47 and ammunition from an undercover FBI agent posing as an ISIS member. Mohamud expressed intentions to kill non-Muslims during a scheduled Hmong arts celebration. US authorities stated that his radicalization was identified well before his plan could be executed.

stories.summary: Wētāpunga, the largest giant wētā species in New Zealand, is rebounding after years of decline caused by habitat destruction and invasive predators. Thanks to dedicated conservation efforts, more than 11,000 wētāpunga have been bred and released into protected areas. With at least four generations now thriving in the wild, the program aims to sustain their growing populations and ensure their future survival.

stories.title: Jason Scott Lee bought 25 acres of damaged Hawaii land to rebuild rainforest and live simply
stories.summary: Hollywood actor Jason Scott Lee transformed 25 acres of damaged Hawaiian land into a simple, self-sufficient home. The property was once littered with car parts, paint cans and debris. Lee grew taro, raised chickens and embraced natural farming while working to restore the rainforest, reflecting his decision to pursue a simpler life away from Hollywood.

stories.title: Howard Hughes' 30,000-acre Las Vegas land buy for $3 an acre eventually became Summerlin

It wasn't until 1988 that plans for Summerlin came to life, culminating in construction that began in 1990, highlighting its residential beginnings. Today, Summerlin has blossomed into a vibrant community spanning 22,500 acres, hosting over 130,000 residents along with schools, parks, and commercial areas, showcasing its rich identity.

stories.summary: Narendra Modi has completed 25 years of service as the head of government in various capacities. Researchers suggest that extreme impacts on the lunar surface caused the formation and preservation of this unusual iron. The findings could enhance our understanding of the Moon's geological history and its evolution over time.

stories.title: Punjab government moves Supreme Court against CBI probe into 'bribe syndicate' linked to CM Bhagwant Mann's OSD
stories.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's government has approached the Supreme Court for an urgent hearing. They aim to challenge a High Court order that mandated a CBI investigation into corruption allegations. The High Court's concerns include alleged coercive actions by the Central Bureau of Investigation in the state. The Punjab government argues that the orders violate governance principles outlined in the Constitution.

stories.title: ED unearths bribe racket involving top executives of 40 PSUs, banks & companies
stories.summary: Enforcement Directorate has uncovered a bribery racket involving executives from at least 40 public sector undertakings and banks. This scheme involved laundering corporate social responsibility funds through multiple trusts operated by a fake doctor. The fake doctor has been impersonating a medical professional for nearly three decades while receiving substantial donations. Investigations revealed kickbacks were paid, with funds returned to donors after deducting commissions.

stories.title: A storm stranded an Outer Banks couple from most of their wedding guests. Then hundreds of strangers showed up
stories.summary: Amidst the storm, Kimberly Laprad and Jayden Sink transformed their wedding on Hatteras Island into a community affair when their guests were unable to make it. Inviting locals resulted in an impressive turnout of 500 to 800 attendees who came together to support the couple. Local businesses generously provided food and services while the couple looks forward to returning every year to contribute to community initiatives.

stories.title: Election Commission: Was ready to meet 240 opposition MPs but not at their chosen venue
stories.summary: Election Commission declined a meeting with opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi at Parliament House annexe. The commission emphasized meetings should occur on its premises and through authorized representatives. Despite being offered a chance to submit a memorandum, the MPs rejected this proposal. The Commission stated it had not received prior appointment requests from the parties until late in the day.

stories.title: Wisconsin homeowner fights data-center power line over land and $81K offer
Cabinet adopts resolution hailing achievements of PM Modi
stories.summary: Cabinet has adopted a resolution recognizing Narendra Modi's 25 years of public service as Chief Minister and Prime Minister. This resolution highlights various policies that benefited the common man, showcasing Modi's governance style. It mentions key initiatives like SWAGAT and PRAGATI that improved governance and service delivery. Additionally, it discusses welfare schemes that helped millions escape poverty and empowered women in society.

stories.title: New dating rewrites history of Oklahoma meteor crater
stories.summary: Researchers from the University of Texas at Austin have traced the Ames meteor impact to approximately 370 million years ago, presenting a significant revision to the previously accepted estimate of 467 million years. This research connects the impact with the Frasnian-Famennian mass extinction event, employing zircon crystals to establish a more precise timeline, thus providing deeper insights into pivotal moments in Earth's geological history.

stories.title: Opposition's anti-SIR-CEC march turns into INDIA bloc-government face-off
stories.summary: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc, led by Rahul Gandhi, organized a protest march to the Election Commission. The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.

stories.title: CBI raids CM Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, his OSD’s home in graft probe
stories.summary: CBI conducted raids on multiple locations including the camp office of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections.

stories.title: In 1987, ancient glass sponge reefs were found alive off Canada's Pacific coast after 40 million years
stories.summary: In 1987, Canadian scientists discovered ancient glass sponge reefs alive in British Columbia’s Hecate Strait, overturning the belief that these reef-building animals had vanished 40 million years ago. More than 9,000 years old, the reefs survive today in Hecate Strait, Queen Charlotte Sound and Howe Sound, creating a rare underwater ecosystem often called the “Sea of Glass.”

stories.title: Cheetahs return to Zambia's Greater Luangwa after nearly 30 years
Maryland manure-lagoon overflow kills nearly 11,000 fish across 25 species, officials say
stories.summary: A tragic incident has unfolded at Basin Run, where nearly 11,000 fish have succumbed to the consequences of a manure lagoon overflow from Kilby Farms. The Maryland Department of the Environment has traced the source of this discharge back to a series of ongoing pollution violations. Local residents, frustrated with the recurring environmental harm, are demanding accountability.

stories.title: Jammu and Kashmir: Arms & drugs seized in cross-border smuggling case; 4 held
stories.summary: J&K Police arrested four suspects linked to cross-border drug and arms smuggling. The police seized a Beretta pistol, magazines, live rounds, and narcotics during this operation. Initial arrests occurred when two men were stopped at a checkpoint and found with heroin and a firearm. This investigation revealed connections with handlers based in Pakistan and previous air-dropped consignments. The case has been registered under relevant laws with further investigation ongoing.

stories.title: Kirk Douglas’ Beverly Hills home with 40+ celebrity autographs sells for $9M
Two sisters turned their childhood love of the ocean into a 65-foot research yacht
stories.summary: Angela Rosenberg and her sister took a significant step by establishing the ANGARI Foundation to fill the void in marine science education. Collaborating with Florida International University, they facilitate student participation in real-world expeditions aboard the research vessel R/V ANGARI. These experiences, including shark tagging and plankton exploration, aim to ignite students' passion for marine science, fostering a connection between youth and the ocean.

stories.title: A Costa Rican cattle ranch became a wildlife haven with 440 bird species
Fort Cronkhite: The abandoned WWII fort near San Francisco where giant 16-inch guns once shook the city
stories.summary: Fort Cronkhite, a former WWII military post in California’s Marin Headlands, once helped protect San Francisco Bay with massive 16-inch guns. Now part of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area, the historic site preserves wartime buildings and military defenses alongside beaches, trails and Pacific views. Visitors can explore Battery Townsley and discover the area’s WWII and Cold War history.

stories.title: Scientists found a new magnetic mineral in Chang’e-6 Moon samples, preserved inside impact-glass particles
stories.summary: A groundbreaking discovery by researchers has unveiled a new magnetic mineral, γ-Fe, found in lunar samples from the Chang'e-6 mission. This remarkable find sheds light on the ancient magnetic environment of the Moon, now long lost. Detailed analysis of tiny iron particles within lunar impact glasses reveals that γ-Fe can maintain stable magnetic signals, potentially serving as a record of the Moon's magnetic history.

stories.title: Cabinet okays new body to bring roads, rail, ports, aviation under one planning framework
stories.summary: India's government has approved the creation of the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority for better planning. This new agency will oversee projects exceeding Rs 500 crore in various sectors. ITLA aims to improve coordination among transport ministries and ensure multi-modal integration. It will develop a comprehensive National Transport Master Plan with a ten-year horizon for effective planning. The authority will also establish a unified transport data repository for project assessment.

stories.title: 'CBI raid at Punjab CM's office result of BJP's frustration': AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal
stories.summary: In a post on X, Kejriwal said the CBI raid was an attempt to target Punjab's elected Chief Minister and alleged that the BJP had consistently "pushed Punjabis around" since coming to power at the Centre, citing the farmers' movement, the issue of Punjab's water and the Punjab University issue.

stories.title: Focus must now be on taking digital literacy, financial literacy to every citizen: Uttarakhand CM
stories.summary: The Chief Minister said the achievement was the result of the hard work and collective participation of teachers, students, neo-literates, volunteers and everyone associated with the campaign while congratulating the people of Uttarakhand on the state becoming the sixth fully literate state in the country.

stories.title: California schoolgirl's sewing project grows into nonprofit with 5,000+ care bags for women
stories.summary: Khloe Thompson, a California teenager, started making care bags for women in need after seeing homelessness. She founded the nonprofit Khloe Kares, which has distributed over 5,000 handmade bags containing personal-care items. The organization collaborates with local businesses and community groups to expand its outreach efforts. Thompson's initiatives have also included supporting children in Ghana and youth workshops on various topics. She received the George H.W.

stories.title: 'Expert in theatrics': BJP hits out at Rahul Gandhi over protest 'drama', row over meeting EC
CM Samrat Choudhary reviews Bihar flood situation, seeks damage report
stories.summary: Bihar has been hit hard by severe floods caused by unprecedented water levels in rivers, leading Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary to assess the situation closely. Several districts reported significant destruction, and immediate relief efforts were set in motion. The Indian Air Force played a vital role by air-dropping food supplies to areas cut off from road access.

stories.title: City-wide low-emission zone for Delhi realistic near-term goal: CAQM official
Barricade stunt, chips, 9-hour dharna and detentions: All that happened at Rahul Gandhi-led CEC protest
4.9-magnitude earthquake hits Uttarakhand's Chamoli, tremors felt in Delhi-NCR
stories.summary: Earthquake tremors felt in Delhi-NCR

stories.title: Miami Beach’s historic Savoy Hotel could face demolition for a 38-story tower
stories.summary: Plans have been submitted to demolish much of the historic Savoy Hotel to construct a new 38-story tower. This project will utilize Florida's Live Local Act to overcome local zoning regulations and historic preservation concerns. The developer aims to retain a small section of the Savoy's facade and lobby in a nod to history. Local officials and preservationists have expressed strong opposition due to potential loss of cultural heritage.

stories.title: Trump says Iran taking out LA and San Diego would be 'small price to pay'
Lithuania ready to cover cost if US establishes military base
stories.summary: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius has declared his willingness to finance the establishment of a permanent US military base in Lithuania. Since 2019, Lithuania has been hosting a rotating US battalion and is eager for a long-term military presence. Concurrently, the Lithuanian parliament is considering lifting constitutional prohibitions on nuclear weapons, a move that has drawn sharp criticism from Russia, citing heightened regional tensions.

stories.title: 'Unusual request': EC explains why it could not meet Rahul Gandhi-led opposition MPs
stories.summary: The Election Commission of India stated that no political party formally requested a meeting as protests occurred. Opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, attempted to march towards the Election Commission to submit a memorandum. The Commission emphasized the need for parties to follow prescribed procedures when seeking meetings. After an unusual request from 240 MPs to meet at Parliament House Annexe, the Commission offered an alternative.

stories.title: FIR against BJP BLA over 'false' Form-7 applications, first such case in Telangana
stories.summary: An FIR has been lodged against BJP Booth Level Agent S Balachander for allegedly filing false voter deletion requests. The complaint, initiated by an election official, triggered a police inquiry. Congress leaders claim these submissions aim to unjustly disenfranchise valid voters from the electoral list. In response, Telangana’s Chief Electoral Officer has ordered District Election Officers to take action against these fraudulent applications.

stories.title: 'Making steady progress, regaining health': Indian embassy in UAE updates on flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar
Jack Dorsey’s Bitchat taken off Indian app stores over law-and-order concerns: Report
stories.summary: Bitchat, a decentralized messaging app by Jack Dorsey, has been removed from Indian app stores. The government cited concerns over potential law and order issues associated with the app’s functionality. Both Apple and Google complied with the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology's request for the app's removal.

stories.title: US House passes resolution honouring Indian flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar, condemns 'act of terrorism'
stories.summary: The US House of Representatives has honored Captain Smit Machchhar through a formal resolution, celebrating his courageous defense of the aircraft against a treacherous act by his co-pilot that placed all lives at risk. The flight safely reached Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, ensuring the passengers' safety. This resolution also acknowledged the vital contributions of off-duty pilots and crew members during the incident.

stories.title: 'Everything will be remembered': Rahul and Priyanka removed from protest site after high drama - watch
150 years, 6 generations and 650 protected acres: The story of a Colorado ranch
stories.summary: Hutchinson Ranch, the oldest family-owned ranch in Colorado’s Upper Arkansas Valley, spans 700 acres along Highway 50. The Hutchinson family has maintained ownership for six generations, successfully implementing conservation agreements protecting 650 acres. These agreements prevent the land from being subdivided for development while allowing the family to continue ranching. Notable historic recognition occurred in 2003 when the ranch was identified among the top endangered properties in Colorado.

stories.title: Pak, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye agree to deploy forces in Gulf country amid Houthi attacks
stories.summary: Pakistan and Turkiye have agreed to provide military support to Saudi Arabia following regional security threats from Houthi rebels. Representatives from the three countries held an emergency meeting to reinforce their Mecca defense agreement. This agreement establishes collective defense provisions that aim for a rapid military deployment if any country is attacked. Additionally, the committee appointed a retired Pakistani General as secretary-general to oversee defense strategies.

stories.title: MacKenzie Scott gave $20m; 5 years later, Denver has 4 new childcare centres
Evening news wrap: MEA condemns attacks on seafarers, IAF gets new chief, opposition steps up protest against CEC and more
In 2014, a Tennessee couple paid 58 cents for Vince Lombardi’s sweater; it later sold for $43,020
stories.summary: In an incredible find, a couple bought a sweater for just 58 cents at a Goodwill store in North Carolina back in 2014. While viewing a documentary, they learned that it had ties to famed football coach Vince Lombardi, as a tag revealed its association with his tenure at West Point. Eventually, it fetched an astonishing $43,020 at auction after being consigned by Lombardi's colleague's widow.

stories.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 for shelters for homeless veterans before Christmas
stories.summary: In 2021, Arnold Schwarzenegger donated $250,000 to Village for Vets to help provide temporary shelters for homeless veterans in Los Angeles. Before Christmas, 25 tiny shelters were installed at the VA campus in West Los Angeles. Each provided a bed, climate control, electricity and a locking door, giving veterans who had been living on the streets a safer place to stay while moving towards stable housing.

stories.title: Florida couple saves colorful Sarasota cottage village housing 17 small businesses from demolition
stories.summary: The anticipated transfer of the Historic Downtown Village in Sarasota to a developer has been called off. The cottages, which accommodate various local enterprises, will remain in the care of Alex and Marlene Lancaster. While business owners faced uncertainty regarding relocation and the emotional fallout of potential displacement, they now breathe a sigh of relief.

stories.title: 'Efforts to hide Iran war costs': US senator alleges denial of access to Al Udeid base in Qatar
'No meeting request received from any party': EC officials as Rahul, Priyanka refuse to leave 'protest site'
stories.summary: Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra staged a protest near the Election Commission's office, even as the EC said it had received no request from any political party seeking a meeting. Cong said they demanded a meeting to discuss alleged electoral irregularities and questioned Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The police intervened and detained several opposition leaders as the protest escalated.

stories.title: Patrick Swayze’s former California ranch with a dance studio listed for $4.5 million after $2.9 million sale
stories.summary: Rancho Bizarro, an extraordinary estate crafted by the artistic duo Patrick Swayze and Lisa Niemi, has hit the market once again. This idyllic ranch boasts state-of-the-art equestrian amenities, a vibrant dance studio, and a cozy main residence. After its acquisition by Aileen Getty in 2015 for $2.9 million, it is now available for $4.5 million.

stories.title: The India mood: Confidence in the country, anxiety about careers
stories.summary: India leads in consumer confidence, yet respondents express significant worries about unemployment and education quality. Many Indians believe the country is on the right track, despite job market uncertainties. The disconnect between economic optimism and job security highlights ongoing issues affecting connected consumers.

stories.title: New Hampshire groundskeeper left $3.8m to his town after living simply
Jharkhand protest: Congress workers scuffle with police outside CEO office
stories.summary: In Ranchi, Congress workers in Jharkhand rallied outside the Chief Electoral Officer's office to protest against Gyanesh Kumar. The demonstration escalated as protestors clashed with police while attempting to breach barriers and defaced the commission's nameplate. Their aim was to draw attention to the challenges citizens face with the electoral roll.

stories.title: 'Once a skunk, always a skunk': DMK questions Rahul Gandhi's stand on Tamil Nadu SIR deletions amid anti-CEC protest
From hunted-out woods to a deer refuge: How a Missouri couple transformed their 300-acre property
stories.summary: Mike and Dana Blevins turned their 300-acre property in Missouri into a thriving habitat for white-tailed deer. After purchasing the land, they implemented habitat management practices supported by the Missouri Department of Conservation. Their efforts contributed to the significant recovery of deer populations in the region, which faced near extinction in the past. As chronic wasting disease poses new challenges, they took part in management efforts to control infections.

stories.title: Wisconsin bargain hunter paid $29 for painting; later identified as Heade, sold for $882,500
stories.summary: In a remarkable turn of events, a man from Wisconsin stumbled upon a magnolia painting for just $29 at a rummage sale in the 1990s. A decade later, the artwork was authenticated as the work of esteemed American artist Martin Johnson Heade. Auctioned at Christie’s, it fetched an astonishing $882,500, shattering initial estimates of $300,000 to $500,000.

stories.title: Andrew Sun-Zhuang built a $260 AI pitching machine with 94% strike accuracy
'Dhappa': Cops tried to stop INDIA bloc's march to EC; Rahul Gandhi pulled a surprise
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra gave the INDIA bloc protest against the Election Commission an unexpected second act after police tried to stop INDIA bloc march against Gyanesh Kumar and began detaining opposition MPs.

stories.title: George Lucas’ sprawling Skywalker Ranch in California
stories.summary: Nestled in Marin County, Skywalker Ranch is a vast 4,700-acre creative sanctuary brought to life by filmmaker George Lucas. This enchanting retreat features a Victorian-style main house used for professional gatherings and boasts Skywalker Sound, operating since 1987. With amenities like themed guest rooms, diverse dining options, and a health club, the ranch remains a unique filmmaking destination, nearly fifty years after its inception.

stories.title: Mayawati says no more expulsions for nephew Akash after father-in-law’s political ‘sanyas’
'Grave concern': MEA condemns attack on MV Royad Mammadov that killed 2 foreign seafarers, injured Indian nationals
US, China in talks for reciprocal visits to nuclear sites in bid to build trust
stories.summary: The United States intends to begin reciprocal visits to nuclear facilities in China, aiming to strengthen trust between the two nations. This proactive initiative seeks to avert a possible arms race amidst escalating worries over China's expanding nuclear arsenal. Currently, officials from both sides are engaging in preliminary talks. A pivotal meeting between US and Chinese leaders is expected later this year to enhance dialogue surrounding nuclear risks and capabilities.

stories.title: Ancient DNA reveals an unknown extinct bovine related to modern yaks
'Learn to serve selflessly from PM Modi': Kiren Rijiju targets Rahul Gandhi over anti-CEC protest
Montana student compares banana and plantain starch to make stronger bioplastic
stories.summary: Rye Lynn Rost, a seventh grader from Montana, created bioplastics using starch from plantains and bananas. She discovered that plantains have more starch and higher tensile strength than bananas. Rye performed tests by comparing both bioplastics against plastic parafilm to evaluate their strength. Her project focuses on making sustainable bioplastics that are durable in environmental conditions over time.

stories.title: 'Attacks must end': MEA says 11 Indian crew members injured in Hormuz vessel strike
Punjab DA case: HC asks chief secretary why criminal contempt proceedings shouldn't begin
stories.summary: Punjab's Chief Secretary, KAP Sinha, faces a contempt notice for allegedly providing misleading statements about the pending dearness allowance. The Punjab and Haryana High Court is scrutinizing his assertions regarding the resolution of issues related to the state's appeal in the Supreme Court. Previously, the court ordered the government to settle overdue dearness allowance for both employees and pensioners.

stories.title: Nintendo destroyed its 1991 Campus Challenge cartridges; one surfaced at a 2006 garage sale, sold for $20,100
stories.summary: In an astounding find, video game enthusiast Rob Walters stumbled upon a rare Nintendo Campus Challenge cartridge at a garage sale back in 2006. This unique cartridge was made for a competitive gaming event in 1991 and hosted modified versions of beloved titles, allowing players to achieve high scores during tournaments.

stories.title: Drones strike two vessels in Bulgaria's economic zone; one ship sinks
stories.summary: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev revealed that drones targeted two commercial ships in Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone, leading to alarming consequences. The Togo-flagged Alfa Watan sank after critical damage, while the Able vessel from Palau caught fire. Remarkably, a Bulgarian ferry was able to rescue all 18 crew members, with two suffering serious injuries.

stories.title: 1928 LA manor once owned by Gene Hackman asks $5.995M
stories.summary: A nearly 100-year-old English-style manor in Woodland Hills is listed for sale at $5.995 million. Originally built in 1928, the property has hosted notable owners like Michael Curtiz and Gene Hackman. The manor features a cobblestone driveway, extensive gardens, and original architectural details that reflect its rich history. Since its last sale in 1994 for $1.71 million, the property's value has significantly increased.

stories.title: Dentist recalls crucial 45 minutes that helped save flydubai hero Captain Smit Machchhar
INDIA bloc protest: Scrap SIR, restore deleted names, sack CEC Gyanesh Kumar - key demands
From climbing barricades to Akashvani Bhawan twist: High drama at Rahul-led CEC protest - how it unfolded
FlyDubai flight incident: Did aviation miss the insider-threat warning?
Ford’s Mexico factory hired a hawk to cut pigeon activity by 80%
In 1934, America created a $1 duck stamp; it has protected 6 million acres
Two Saudi airports in Jazan and Najran targeted as tension with Yemen's Houthis escalates
Florida woman rides 7,000 miles, raises $17,560 for charity that helped her two decades ago
stories.summary: A Florida woman completed a 7,000-mile motorcycle journey across 48 states in six days. She raised $17,560 for Quantum House, an organization that supported her during her daughter’s hospital stay. The ride attracted attention, allowing her to create awareness about the organization. Jess's daughter, who benefitted from Quantum House, joined her when she presented the raised funds.

stories.title: 'Wanted to tarnish image': Delhi Police on man held over alleged AI poster showing cop sexually assaulting woman
stories.summary: Delhi Police arrested a 24-year-old man named Nadeem Ahmed for creating a fake poster featuring a police officer. Police said the poster falsely depicted the officer sexually assaulting a woman during a protest, intending to damage police credibility. Investigators said Nadeem claimed to be an independent journalist and used AI tools for his misleading content.

stories.title: South African tycoon to spend $402M turning 600-hectare farm into F1 circuit by 2031
stories.summary: Neal Froneman leads a consortium aiming to construct a $402 million Formula 1 circuit near Cape Town, marking a potential revival of South African motorsport after nearly 40 years. Currently in the pre-feasibility phase, the circuit is designed to accommodate 125,000 fans and will include a media complex and entertainment spots. If the endeavor succeeds, it could generate over 15,000 local jobs, enhancing tourism and the economy.

stories.title: Meryl Streep’s seven-figure gift is bringing women’s history to classrooms
'Acted of his own volition': ACP Bhagat steps aside from Addl DCP charge amid harassment probe
'Largely irrelevant': Jaishankar says UN failing on Gulf, Ukraine, Africa and Covid
Ageing mice study finds why 'zombie cells' evade immune clearance and fuel inflammation
stories.summary: Researchers studying ageing in mice have found that a decline in chaperone-mediated autophagy (CMA), a cellular recycling process, helps “zombie cells” accumulate by weakening the immune system’s ability to clear them. Restoring CMA reduced senescent-cell buildup, inflammation and fibrosis in mice, pointing to a possible new approach to age-related diseases.

stories.title: Abhijeet Dipke claims CJP activists receiving police notices threatening October 10 protest 'could turn violent'
North Dakota governor’s residence project uncovers seven coffins and human remains
Golfer's $5 thrift-store jacket sells for $139,349
stories.summary: A golfer made a surprising find in 1994 when he bought a striking green jacket for only $5 at a Toronto thrift shop. To his amazement, it turned out to be a genuine Augusta National club jacket dating back to the 1950s. By 2017, this piece of history sold for an impressive $139,349 at auction, illustrating the escalating demand and skyrocketing prices for rare golf collectibles in today’s marketplace.

stories.title: 40 oyster reefs placed along Gandy's Beach in New Jersey to support live oysters and cut storm-wave
stories.summary: A New Jersey project that began installing 40 constructed oyster reefs along about 800 metres of Gandy’s Beach in 2015 recorded more than 800 live oysters per square metre during early monitoring. Researchers also found the reefs reduced storm-wave height by up to 51% under certain conditions, though seven years of monitoring showed continued elevation and vegetation loss at the site.

stories.title: Jeff McKissack built Houston’s Orange Show from salvaged materials in 1968
Atlanta’s 14-story Presidential Hotel opened in 1973; now a $53.3m plan could turn it into 282 apartments after decades vacant
stories.summary: DeKalb County has approved an initiative to transform the empty Presidential Hotel into modern market-rate apartments. This $53.3 million project will feature 282 residential units, including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom layouts, with expected completion by the end of next year. Local residents have welcomed this development as a major enhancement to the community's housing options.

stories.title: Germany is turning abandoned coal mines into 23 lakes and a wetland landscape
Michigan man turns old bike parts into prosthetic legs; gives design away for free
stories.summary: Ben Hogan, once a bike mechanic, established Project Bike Leg with a vision to fabricate prosthetics from recycled bicycle components. His mission is to aid impoverished amputees worldwide who struggle to find affordable prosthetic options. Through engaging instructional videos on his website, Hogan empowers others to create their own bike legs.

stories.title: Meet Sartaj Singh Gandhi, the student who built a sensor to detect spoiled meat
stories.summary: Sartaj Singh Gandhi, a brilliant seventh grader, has innovatively developed a device that monitors the freshness of various meats by tracking ammonia gas released during decay. His research revealed that peak ammonia levels were detected on day six of testing turkey, chicken, pork, and beef. With plans to broaden the device's capabilities to other food types, Sartaj dreams of a future in cardiothoracic surgery.

stories.title: 'Gyanesh, it’s done, bro, time to resign': Rahul Gandhi as INDIA bloc march to EC stopped
Southern California’s mountain frogs begin their return with 650 releases
219 box turtles rescued after hundreds were dumped near New Jersey river
stories.summary: The Mercer County Wildlife Center is diligently working to rehabilitate 219 abandoned box turtles, found near Cranford, New Jersey, back in July. A significant rescue operation was launched after these turtles were discovered by the riverbank. With winter on the horizon, the center is building outdoor enclosures to allow the turtles to brumate naturally.

stories.title: Soldiers looking for land mines in South Korea have found the country's oldest gun dating back to more than 600 years
stories.summary: In a fascinating search for hidden landmines, South Korean troops discovered a small bronze gun buried beneath the earth. Dubbed a Hwangja Hwatong, this artifact dates back to the 14th or 15th century. The intricate details engraved on it can help historians piece together Korea's journey in firearm technology and military tactics from the times of the Goryeo and early Joseon dynasties.

stories.title: 650 drones overnight: Ukraine unleashes massive strike on Moscow region
‘Unacceptable’: India reacts after Russian strike injures Indian sailor on Black Sea ship
stories.summary: India has strongly condemned the attack on the MV ROYAD MAMMADOV in the Black Sea, which tragically resulted in the deaths of two foreign nationals. Among the injured was an Indian sailor, prompting the Indian Embassy in Romania to act swiftly. They assured that all Indian crew members are safe and receiving medical care. External affairs minister S Jaishankar raised maritime safety issues at the United Nations General Assembly.

stories.title: Nigerian Air Force plane crashes, killing all 25 passengers and 7 crew
'Creating anarchy to relaunch Rahul': BJP on Congress's Form 6 claims
Salt Ponds Become Wetlands: Restoration revives rich habitat; 80 bird species return
stories.summary: Restoration efforts in South San Diego Bay converted former salt ponds into functional tidal wetlands. Wildlife has shown significant recovery with 80 species of birds, 22 species of fish, and 10 species of invertebrates observed. The project aimed to restore natural tidal flows and enhance habitat diversity. Native plants began emerging quickly after the restoration, indicating ecological recovery.

stories.title: Delhi court grants bail to 17 students, journalists arrested during CEC protest
Case against Bhagwant Mann's OSD: Punjab govt to move SC against HC order for CBI probe into ED's graft allegations
'More skeletons are tumbling out': Congress trains guns at EC over new report on Bengal polls
Bengal bypolls: AJUP chief Humayun Kabir detained in Murshidabad after casting vote
Native plants are helping restore habitat in Florida's Saint Sebastian River
Jeffrey Archer, author and former British politician, dies at 86
'Tarique hasn't ruled out India visit': Dhaka
stories.summary: Bangladesh has highlighted the importance of trust and bilateral engagement for future relations with India. State Minister Humaiun Kobir stated that preventing extremists in India from making destabilizing statements is necessary. He mentioned that mutual respect is required for maintaining good relations between the two countries. A potential visit by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to India is under consideration, emphasizing direct dialogue.

stories.title: US nuke test detection experiment bid to assert its hegemony: Ex-nuclear chief
stories.summary: Anil Kakodkar commented on the US conducting a non-proliferation experiment to enhance detection capabilities of nuclear explosions. This experiment aims to ensure the US maintains its nuclear hegemony and deters other nations from nuclear tests. The Federation of American Scientists reported India's nuclear warhead status and capabilities. The National Nuclear Security Administration explained that the experiment involved advanced sensor measurements for better detection.

stories.title: National Commission for Women seeks gender-neutral childcare leave, shared caregiving by parents
stories.summary: National Commission for Women has proposed several recommendations to improve maternity and childcare laws in India. The commission advocates for gender-neutral childcare leave to be extended to the private sector. It also suggests increasing leave for adoptive mothers from 12 weeks to 26 weeks. Recommendations include creating more childcare facilities and offering maternity benefits to informal workers. The focus is on shared parenting and establishing family-friendly workplaces throughout the country.

stories.title: Delhi Police ACP Vivek Bhagat’s additional DCP charge withheld amid harassment inquiry
stories.summary: Delhi government modified an order regarding duty charges of 12 police officers after harassment allegations surfaced. Assistant Commissioner of Police Vivek Bhagat voluntarily stepped aside from his additional charge as the inquiry continues. The CDC assignment began prior to the allegations, ensuring it does not indicate a promotion. The complaints have been transferred to the Crime Branch for a detailed investigation and fair inquiry.
